descriptions.preferred: 'Kogane nishiki' is a strong-growing tree for background or overstory plantings. The medium-sized fiveto seven-lobed leaves are a deep, rich green. The lobes are longovate with acuminate points and are fairly deeply separated. The edges are lightly toothed. Spring leaves have yellow tips, then change to a strong Acer Gelderen. Vertrees. green for summer. Fall color is a bright gold. This tree reaches 33 ft. (10 m) in 20 years. It makes a good base plant for landscapes, and the golden fall color can work as a contrast to other plant- Acer ings. A site in full sun is best. The name means Vertrees. "golden brocade."

rhs.description: A compact, bushy, rounded, upright deciduous tree reaching a height of around 4m in height, with feathery, lobed green leaves with inconspicuous yellow tips emerging in spring, turning to golden yellow and orange in the autumn. Provides texture and movement to smaller gardens and ideal for a large pot or container

attributes.suggested_uses: Architectural, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants, Rock Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适用于观赏型种植、城市或庭院花园、乡村或自然式花园、花境与花坛、低维护栽培、庭院容器栽培以及岩石园。

care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 一款紧凑、丛生、树冠圆整且直立的落叶小乔木，最终高度约 4 米。春季萌发羽状深裂的绿色叶，叶尖带不显著的黄色，秋季转为金黄与橙色。可为较小庭园带来细腻质感与动态感，也非常适合大型盆器或容器栽培。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Kogane nishiki' 是一个生长势强的树形品种，适合作背景树或上层栽植。中等大小的叶片为五至七裂，叶色深而浓绿。裂片呈长卵形，先端渐尖，裂片间分离较深。叶缘有浅锯齿。春叶叶尖带黄色，随后转为适合夏季观赏的浓绿色；秋色为明亮的金黄色。20 年可长至 10 米。该树种适合作景观中的基调树，其金黄色秋叶可与其他栽植形成对比。以全日照位置最佳。其名意为“金色锦缎”。 'Kogane sakae' 为 Amoenum Group 的绿色矮生类型，是一个颇为特别的品种，以枝皮颜色著称。极嫩的新梢及较老枝条呈浅绿色，并带黄绿色条纹及不规则斑纹。叶片中到大型，七裂，分裂深达叶基的一半；裂片呈卵形，在中部最宽。叶缘细锯齿。春季叶色鲜绿，叶尖带红；秋色为淡橙至黄色。该品种树形强健而直立，高度可达 10-13 米。其名意为“金色繁荣”。
